Please do **NOT** open a public issue to report a security vulnerability. 

Instead, refer to our [Security Policy](../../SECURITY.md) (or check `/.github/SECURITY.md`) to report vulnerabilities privately and safely. Thank you for helping keep the BFFX community secure!
